description: Header file defining the 'rio' I/O stream abstraction for Redis, including function prototypes, struct definitions, and inline functions for reading, writing, and managing stream state.

methods.name: rioWrite
methods.description: Inline function to write data to the rio stream, updating checksum and processed bytes.

methods.name: rioRead
methods.description: Inline function to read data from the rio stream, updating checksum and processed bytes.

methods.name: rioTell
methods.description: Inline function to get current position in the rio stream.

methods.name: rioFlush
methods.description: Inline function to flush the rio stream.
